tools.name: find_stock_token
tools.description: Find issuer-listed tokenized stocks on a chain by ticker, company name or ISIN. Returns the official contract addresses. An empty result says only that the issuer lists no such token, nothing about impostors. Two chains: base (Coinbase's tokens, symbols end in "c", e.g. NVDAc) and robinhood (Robinho

tools.name: list_stock_tokens
tools.description: List every token in a chain's issuer registry: symbol, name, contract address, ISIN, multiplier, whether it is minted on the chain and whether the issuer publishes a reference price. The answer opens with the exact count (also the `count` field); quote that number, do not estimate it from the list.

tools.name: stock_passport
tools.description: Passport of one token address: whether it is in the issuer registry (and, if not, which listed stock its name imitates); the issuer reference price and its age; the latest DEX price and its premium over the reference; the premium series split by US market session; and every gap named. Readings are r

tools.name: verify_stock_tokens
tools.description: Before buying a token that claims to be a stock, check its contract address: is it on the issuer's own registry for this chain (Base: Coinbase; robinhood: Robinhood)? Up to 50 addresses per call. listed=true is decided by the exact address alone. listed=false means "not in this issuer's registry", n

tools.name: recent_impostors
tools.description: Tokens on a chain whose symbol or name copies an issuer-listed stock token while their contract is not in that registry, newest first (at most 50), optionally since an ISO time. Each names what it imitates and the listed address. A claim with evidence, not a verdict.

tools.name: compare_venues
tools.description: For shares listed on BOTH Base (Coinbase) and Robinhood Chain (Robinhood), matched by ISIN: per venue the on-chain price's premium over that venue's own issuer reference, the reference kind and age, the deepest pool's liquidity and the multiplier, and the gap (Robinhood premium minus Base premium) w
